evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/runelite/a/d extends the client linked-list Node and otherwise contains exactly eight mutable integer values plus a default constructor; it has no unrelated behavior.

The only non-self class reference in the exact jar is recovered RSInterface. Its model-building path allocates this class, stores it in an rs/F node cache keyed by the interface model ID, and reloads it on later model construction.

RSInterface copies eight exact Model bounds values into the entry after Model.m(): min/max X, min/max Z, model height, bottom Y, radius and diameter. On a cache hit it restores those same eight values back into the newly prepared Model before returning it.

The cache entry is created only when the RSInterface model-bounds caching flag is enabled; first use calculates Model bounds, snapshots them, inserts the Node into the cache, and subsequent uses restore the snapshot without recomputing the full bounds scan.

proposals.note: ModelBoundsCacheEntry is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the Node-backed eight-int cache record used exclusively by RSInterface to snapshot and restore Model bounds. No original developer identifier is claimed; confidence is 0.998.
